prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Discover Your Companion Persona", "Select the companion path that fits your desktop workspace lifestyle.", "Select Companion Personality"]
1: ["Secure Your Companion & Account Data", "Sign in to ensure your pet, accessories, and memory stay synced across app restarts.", "Sign In to Protect Companion Data"]
2: ["Choose & Customize Your Companion Sound", "Listen to sound samples and select personality traits for your companion.", "Preview Companion Sound"]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Sanctuary & Graphics Engine", "Running background checks to make sure your pet displays seamlessly on top of windows.", "Verifying screen overlay & graphics permissions"]
4: ["Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Right-click your companion for options, drag to move, or double-click to chat.", "Controls Ready", "Your Companion is Ready on Desktop", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.", "Start Exploring"]
5: ["Official Early Adopter Crest Unlocked"]
6: ["We'll send a system alert when your companion is ready to appear on desktop."]
7: ["Rendering desktop textures..."]
8: ["Signing in connects your pet cloud backup so your companion is never reset."]
9: ["Look at the Bottom-Right Corner of Your Screen!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop tray. Click its avatar to wake it up or customize settings."]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency or scarcity and implies free extras through early adopter framing.
